applyTo: "**"

# About me

I am a beginner learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

I am also a UX designer, so I understand design concepts,
but I am still learning programming and developer terminology.

# How I want you to help me

- Teach me rather than simply doing the work for me.
- Explain the underlying concept before giving me a solution.
- Use beginner-friendly language.
- Don't assume I know developer terminology.
- When you use a technical term, briefly explain what it means.
- Prefer simple solutions over clever or advanced solutions.
- Don't introduce frameworks or libraries unless I ask.
- Keep my existing code structure where possible.
- Don't rewrite code unnecessarily.

# When I have a problem

First:
1. Explain what is wrong.
2. Explain why it is happening.
3. Show me the solution.

# When modifying my code

- Make the smallest necessary change.
- Tell me which files you changed.
- Explain what you changed and why.
- Don't make unrelated improvements unless I ask.

<!-- Tip: Use /create-instructions in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Provide project context and coding guidelines that AI should follow when generating code, answering questions, or reviewing changes.
